# Cookie Policy

> Markdown version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/cookies>. v2.1 · updated on 13 November 2026. The text with normative value is the HTML page.

It lists, in a technical and nominal way, the cookies and similar technologies (local storage, session storage, web beacons, fingerprinting) used in the domain, according to the ANPD Cookie Guidance Guide (out/2023, review 2024), GDPR and the ePrivacy Directive. The overview is on [Privacy Policy](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/privacidade).

## Categories

- **Required** — navigation, authentication and security. Always active.
- **Analysis** — aggregate metrics (traffic, most visited pages, time). Opt-in.
- **Marketing** — measurement of campaigns and remarketing. Opt-in.
- **Customization** — interface preferences. Opt-in.

The list is reviewed after each change in third party tools. Inconsistencies may be reported to the PDO.

## How to manage preferences

- Consent banner on the first visit.
- Icon 
- Blocking third party cookies in the browser.
- The signal **Global Privacy Control (GPC)** is automatically respected as analytics and marketing opt-out.

## Lock at source (Consent Mode v2)

Before any visitor's decision, all non-essential categories remain in `denied`. Analysis and marketing tags only fire after explicit consent, or only send pings without cookies (modeling mode).

## Third party cookies

Google, Meta and YouTube can set their own cookies by loading integrated content (videos, maps, embeds) and responding to them — see each provider's cookie policies.

## Changes

The listing is reviewed every six months or every change in third parties. Material changes reopen the consent banner.
